en: A vintage postcard showing a grand, historic building surrounded by lush trees and a park-like setting. The building, decorated with ornate architectural features, has 'PALACE HOTEL' written on its facade. There are people walking and an individual riding a bicycle. The image has an old, hand-tinted appearance, typical of early 20th-century postcards. At the top, the text 'ZAGREB. Akademički trg' is printed.
